```python
import matplotlib.patches as patches

intervals = [
    (datetime(2021, 3, 5, 0), datetime(2021, 3, 7, 0)),
    (datetime(2021, 3, 12, 0), datetime(2021, 3, 14, 0))
]

for start, end in intervals:
    rect = patches.Rectangle(
        (start, ax.get_ylim()[0]),
        end - start,
        ax.get_ylim()[1] - ax.get_ylim()[0],
        linewidth=0,
        edgecolor='none',
        facecolor=(0.75, 0.75, 0, 0.3)
    )
    ax.add_patch(rect)
```
